style: Art-rock avant-garde dance theater with West African and Middle Eastern acoustic instrumentation. Harmony operates under 1/3-comma meantone with quartal suspended fields and sharp wolf-interval friction. Melodic behavior features fast ornamented Ney runs and Santur tremolos, interspersed with spoken Yiddish-L1-transferred English. Rhythmic physics utilize a 6-pulse substrate running a 3:2 polyrhythmic coupling, nested tuplets, and foot-stomp floor resonance. Timbre showcases dry separated acoustic sources: Udu bass pings, Darbuka doums, Berimbau twangs, Zampoña breath, and Shekere seed-shake, captured with radio-telescope high-frequency hiss and periodic public-access television dropouts. Performance attitude is aggressively cheerful and relentlessly upbeat, treating logical confuddlement as an exciting structural victory. The anchor invariant is a recurring four-note santur ostinato that mutates rhythmically across section handoffs while retaining its precise pitch contour.

caption: An aggressively cheerful avant-garde art-rock piece driven by Yoruba-influenced English phrasing, Persian santur ostinatos, and a 3:2 polyrhythmic foot-stomp grid. Guided by taxonomic confuddlement and ontological decompilation, the song treats unicorn farts and rainbow sparkles as certified administrative events while error counts systematically delete instruments and signal dropouts shatter the public-access broadcast.
